text:
sophie.l: Quick sync: MeridianTrust POC. Requirements: IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM delta provisioning (high churn contractors), Okta group->role mapping, tenant domain proofing across multiple brands, EU-only data residency. Need runbook + ballpark Hosted vs Dedicated pricing for presales. who can own?

matt.d: I can do runbook. question: expected SCIM peak ops/hour? impacts quota rec.

vivian.z: Sales note: ~15k users, 4k DAU, nightly full upsert, spikes during onboarding weeks (~5k ops/hour). They prefer SCIM-first with JIT fallback. Delegated tenant admins required.

sophie.l: Can we map Okta groups into a custom SAML role claim and support multiple values? any limits?

matt.d: Yes. we emit multi-valued attributes. watch assertion size if group count very large; will add guidance. nested groups should be flattened at IdP or via small sync job.

pricing-bot: pricing-bot: Draft estimates uploaded: hosted_standard ~$1.1k/mo; hosted_plus_scim ~$2.9k/mo; dedicated_onboarding $20k one-time; dedicated_recurring ~$7.5k/mo (EU premium may apply). figures provisional.

vivian.z: please include sample SCIM PATCH for delta replay in runbook. also include domain-proofing note: GA supports exact domain verification per tenant; wildcard/delegated not GA (can be SOW for Dedicated).

matt.d: Will add SCIM PATCH snippet and SAML metadata example. sample SCIM PATCH:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://eu.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/42" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails","value":[{"value":"jane@brand.example"}]}]}'
```

sophie.l: Great. i'll update CRM, attach security questionnaire answers, and schedule tech call for Thurs 15:00 CET. adding sec and ops to the invite.

vivian.z: i'll push the draft quote link once pricing is validated. thanks team. :thumbsup:
